While it is functionally a sawmill, it lacks the defining visual characteristics of the specified class. The background wall has a smeared, painterly quality inconsistent with real concrete weathering (Severity 2 is appropriate). The machinery geometry shows subtle warping and alignment issues typical of AI generation (Severity 2 is appropriate). Additionally, upon closer inspection, the connection between the horizontal beam and the vertical post in the mid-ground right appears fused and structurally ambiguous, reinforcing the structural integrity issues. The Router did not underestimate these severities; they accurately reflect the degree of hallucination present.
